# The MCP server runs over stdio, as a child of the harness

> No port, no network, no token: containment by construction rather than by policy.

Applies to `crates/**`.

<!-- archwarden:yours -->

## Context

_Everything between these two markers is yours. archwarden never rewrites it._

<!-- archwarden:end -->

## Considered and rejected

- **HTTP per workspace with an ephemeral token** (nothing refuses it) — Easier to reach from any runtime — and *anything* in that runtime reaches the server, not just the agent. Containment by policy, not by construction.
- **No MCP server at all, context injection only** (nothing refuses it) — Injection serves what was anticipated; querying serves what was not.

## What keeps it

Nothing can. A transport choice lives in how a process is spawned, not in what any file imports.
